h1: KC Grande Resort & Spa — A Beachfront Resort with 4 Pools on White Sand Beach, Beachside Rooms and Hillside Jacuzzis
intro: If you want a resort you can walk straight from your room onto White Sand Beach but still pick from several pools, KC Grande Resort & Spa is one of the names Koh Chang regulars mention most · A large resort in the heart of White Sand Beach (Hat Sai Khao), split into two sides — a beachside section on the sand and a newer hillside section across the road where rooms come with jacuzzis · There are four pools: a beachfront pool with a bar, a rooftop pool, and a hillside pool with a kids' waterslide · Around 208 rooms, a spa, fitness centre and a beachfront restaurant · From approx. ฿2,800/night, scoring 8.9 from around 497 reviews

body.html: KC Grande Resort & Spa sits at the northern end of White Sand Beach (Hat Sai Khao), the most popular beach on Koh Chang · The thing guests agree on most is the location and the beach — fine white sand, swimmable water right out front, and a short walk to the cluster of restaurants, convenience stores and bars on White Sand Beach · The resort is fairly large, around 208 rooms, clearly split into two sides: a beachside section on the sand, and a hillside section across the road.

The difference between the two sides is the key thing to know before booking · The beachside has garden-view and sea-view Deluxe rooms plus beachfront villas you can step straight onto the sand from — classic tropical-resort feel · The hillside rooms are newer and more modern in design, many with a private jacuzzi on the balcony and some with pool access — but you cross the road to reach the beach · Guests who want a newer room with good design and a jacuzzi tend to pick the hillside, while those who want to wake up and walk onto the sand choose the beachside.
"The beach out front is gorgeous — white sand, genuinely swimmable — the beachfront pool has an amazing sea view, and you walk straight out to the mid-beach restaurants. Great value for a family."

Plenty to do is the other reason this reads as a family resort · There are four pools — a beachfront pool with a swim-up bar, a rooftop pool with a sea view, and a hillside pool with a kids' waterslide · Beyond the pools there's a spa, sauna, fitness centre and watersports like kayaking · The buffet breakfast is rated well, with a wide spread · The overall mood is a big, lively resort that suits families and groups of friends rather than a quiet, secluded retreat.

Two honest caveats stand out · First, some beachside rooms are noticeably older than the hillside ones — several reviews call the older rooms tired, with some fittings showing their age, so book the hillside or a renovated room if you want something newer · Second, it gets busy in high season and the beach bar plays music at night — rooms near the bar can hear it, so ask for one set further back if you're a light sleeper.

Location is the biggest strength — you're in the heart of White Sand Beach, a few minutes' walk to the beach's restaurants, convenience stores and nightlife · It's about 15 minutes by car to Kai Bae Beach and 10–15 minutes to Klong Prao · Getting here from Bangkok means driving to the Trat-side piers (Laem Ngop / Ao Thammachat / Centrepoint), taking the ferry across to Koh Chang, then a songthaew or taxi to White Sand Beach, which is in the north of the island and closest to the piers · A score of 8.9 from around 497 Trip.com reviews is strong and steady for a resort this size.

The straight verdict: KC Grande is one of the best-rounded beachfront picks on White Sand Beach for families and anyone who wants both a fine beach and lots of pools · It's genuinely on the sand, the white-sand beach is swimmable, there are four pools, you can walk to dinner, and there's a wide spread of room tiers for different budgets · The trade-offs to accept are the older beachside rooms, the un-quiet vibe and beach-bar noise when busy · If those three sit fine with you and you pick the right side, the value and location are hard to match on White Sand Beach.

A tip from following the reviews here for a while: if you want a newer room with a jacuzzi, go hillside; if you want to wake up and walk onto the sand, go beachside — don't just grab the cheapest rate without checking which side you'll get · Ask for a room away from the beach bar if you're a light sleeper · For high season (November–February), book ahead and lock a free-cancellation rate first, then compare across platforms · The rainy season is quieter and cheaper on Koh Chang, but some days bring strong surf — check the forecast and ferry sailings before you go.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — KC Grande Resort & Spa Koh Chang

faq.q: Where is KC Grande Resort and what's nearby?
faq.a: The resort sits at the northern end of White Sand Beach (Hat Sai Khao), Koh Chang, Trat Province — the island's most popular beach · It's about a 5-minute walk to the beach's cluster of restaurants, convenience stores and bars · Around 10–15 minutes by car to Klong Prao Beach and about 15 minutes to Kai Bae · White Sand Beach is closest to the ferry piers, so getting on and off the island is easy.

faq.q: How much does KC Grande Resort cost and what room types are there?
faq.a: Rates start at approximately ฿2,800/night for a beachside Deluxe · It steps up through the Jacuzzi Deluxe Hillside (hillside room with a private jacuzzi), the Sea View Grande Deluxe (approx. 50 sqm, sea view) and the Family Suite (approx. 100 sqm, sleeps 4) · High-season rates climb quickly, so compare across platforms before booking.

faq.q: What's the difference between the beachside and hillside rooms?
faq.a: The beachside has garden/sea-view Deluxe rooms and beachfront villas you can step onto the sand from — classic tropical feel, though some rooms are older · The hillside rooms are newer and more modern, many with a private jacuzzi and some with pool access, but you cross the road to reach the beach · Choose based on whether you want a newer room or to be right on the sand.

faq.q: Is the beach in front of KC Grande good for swimming?
faq.a: The beach out front is White Sand Beach — fine white sand and genuinely swimmable, considered one of the best beaches on Koh Chang · Beyond the beach there are four pools to choose from: a beachfront pool with a bar, a rooftop pool with a sea view, and a hillside pool with a kids' waterslide.

faq.q: Who is KC Grande Resort best for?
faq.a: It's a great fit for families and groups of friends who want a beachfront resort on White Sand Beach with several pools and plenty to do · You can walk to the beach's restaurants and nightlife, and there's a wide range of room tiers for different budgets · It's not a quiet, secluded retreat — if peace is the priority, consider a resort on another beach.

faq.q: How far ahead should I book, and how do I get there?
faq.a: For high season (November–February), book about 3–6 weeks ahead as it's a popular White Sand Beach resort · From Bangkok, drive to the Trat-side piers, take the ferry across to Koh Chang, then a songthaew to White Sand Beach, which is closest to the piers · Pick a Free Cancellation rate if your plans aren't firm, and compare across platforms.
